title: ASOBO_sky_portal glTF extension
description: Glider schema (A3.7), written from the MSFS 2024 Blender exporter (io/com/extensions/light/asobo_skyportal_light.py); no schema ships with the SDK. A node extension: a window area light facing into the cabin along the node's +Z axis (the exporter's 180 degree X rotation).

shape_type.description: Portal shape: 1 = disc (the only sky-portal shape).

source_radius.description: Disc radius in centimetres (the exporter UI unit; Blender preview radius = value / 100 m).

inner_cone_angle.description: Full inner cone angle in degrees (SDK: defines the portal's inner circle).

outer_cone_angle.description: Full outer cone angle in degrees (SDK: always 180).
